project_info.theme: Student success story for admission to French medical preparatory programs
project_info.color_palette: Cream, Red, Navy, Black, Warm Skin Tones

main_subject.detail: A scrapbook-style student case study for Lê Tuấn Hùng featuring two photos of the student, a top-right panel listing three French universities, a mini Eiffel Tower prop, and a long bullet list describing his admission to highly selective French medical preparatory studies.
main_subject.style: Admissions-proof collage poster with paper textures, clip elements, school logos, and bold red name typography.

items: Top Left: VFE logo and large red-white name lockup 'LÊ TUẤN HÙNG'.
Top Right: Torn note pinned with university logos for Paris-Saclay, Université Paris Cité, and Université de Rouen Normandie.
Bottom Left: Polaroid-style lower portrait of the student and red CTA button 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY'.
Bottom Right: Long bullet-point achievements list in red and black text.
Center/Background: Main portrait of the student holding a red diploma booklet, paper layers, binder clip, mini Eiffel Tower ornament, and cream dotted-paper board.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clear student identity, readable logo and bullet text, and layered admissions-collage depth.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality student success case study poster for Lê Tuấn Hùng. Centerpiece is a scrapbook collage with a main portrait of the student in graduation robe holding a red diploma booklet, a second portrait below, and a pinned note listing three French universities. Background is a cream dotted-paper admissions board with VFE branding and paper clips. Surrounding elements: red-white name text 'LÊ TUẤN HÙNG', universities Paris-Saclay, Université Paris Cité, and Université de Rouen Normandie, detailed academic bullet points, mini Eiffel Tower prop, and red CTA 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY'. Technical style: scrapbook-style admissions case study poster, soft editorial lighting, high proof fidelity, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
